instruction: Begin by reviewing freecad_task-3_input.step in FreeCAD. On this machine, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-3_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Add four vertical cylindrical mounting posts on the top face of the base plate. Each post must have diameter 10 mm and height 16 mm, with its bottom face on Z=8 mm. The post center coordinates are (15,15), (75,15), (15,45), and (75,45). Fuse the posts with the existing base and center boss into one continuous solid, then export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-3_output.step.
